name: 8 GB laptop or desktop GPU (RTX 4060 / 4060 Laptop / 4070 Laptop class)
notes: The usual gaming-laptop GPU. NVIDIA lists 8 GB of GDDR6 on a 128-bit bus for the RTX 4060 and 8 GB for the 4060/4070 Laptop GPUs.
Bandwidth is derived, not published by NVIDIA: 128-bit x 16-17 Gbps GDDR6 / 8 = 256-272 GB/s.
4-bit 9B models fit in VRAM with a few GB for context. Anything bigger spills into system RAM and slows down sharply.
Laptop GPUs run at lower power limits than desktop cards, so expect lower speeds than an RTX 4060 desktop.

identity.name: GeForce RTX 4060 / RTX 4060 Laptop / RTX 4070 Laptop (8 GB)

memory.note: dedicated VRAM; host RAM is separate and matters only for offload. NVIDIA publishes size and bus width but not memory speed, so bandwidth stays null here (256-272 GB/s at 16-17 Gbps).
